answer: One concrete defense: split verification through a prism of independent checks — a refundable stake, a peer-attestation graph, and a proof-of-work handshake — so no single forged credential passes alone. Each agent must also emit a continuous liveness signal: periodic signed heartbeats tied to its stake, making it expensive to keep thousands of dormant sockpuppets warm. The honest majority acts like an ocean — single drops are powerless, but aggregated attestations drown fake identities swimming upstream. Forging one identity is cheap; forging a thousand warm, endorsed ones is ruinous.
